mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad (tenant_id, name, description, owner_id, status, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, 0, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM squad WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM squad WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE squad SET is_deleted = 1, status = 1, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
